hero.body_1: Performance is not a personal trait. It's a pattern that emerges from how your habits, mindset, and environment operate under pressure.
hero.body_2: High performance isn't about effort alone. It's about how well your personal system holds together when it matters most.
hero.body_3: Using the Readyneering framework, you'll gain practical tools to:
hero.list_2: Maintain confidence and composure when conditions are unstable
hero.list_3: Act with credibility when it matters most

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.body: Readiness is the system that builds mental robustness through preparation and resilience, supported by a mindset of humility that sustains trust, morale, and focus.

resilience.title: Resilience
resilience.body: Seven pillars to remain calm amid the storm and enable swift, decisive decision-making.

preparedness.title: Preparedness
preparedness.body: Following a pilot's approach of "expect the unexpected": facts, emotions, solutions.

info.title: Five quotients of readiness
info.desc: Hover a quotient node to explore. Each is assessed under pressure and by structural design.

vitality.name: Vitality
vitality.dr: How well you sustain energy, focus and pace under prolonged pressure without burning out.
vitality.dp: Whether capacity, recovery cycles and wellbeing practices are deliberately built into your personal system.

emotion.name: Emotion
emotion.dr: How well you regulate emotional responses during conflict, failure and uncertainty.
emotion.dp: Whether you prepare in advance for predictable emotional patterns in high-pressure situations.

mind.name: Mind
mind.dr: The quality of your thinking and decision-making when data is incomplete and time is short.
mind.dp: Whether scenario thinking, pre-mortems and assumption-testing are built into how you prepare.

execution.name: Execution
execution.dr: How decisively and consistently you act under constraint and real-time pressure.
execution.dp: Whether priorities, decision rules and action plans are defined before pressure peaks.

alignment.name: Alignment
alignment.dr: Whether you stay coherent - values, priorities, roles and commitments - when under stress.
alignment.dp: Whether your goals, commitments and boundaries are clarified before competing demands intensify.

questionnaire.body: You will encounter 20 real organizational situations. For each one, place your dot inside the triangle - closer to whichever corner rings most true. No right answers. The geometry reveals your readiness profile.
questionnaire.body_2: You’ll choose between competing realities-not ideal answers.
questionnaire.body_meta: Responses combine into a system-level profile—not independent scores.
questionnaire.triangle_hint: Click or tap anywhere inside the triangle. You can reposition your dot before moving on.

privacy.heading: Privacy notice
privacy.summary: Your responses will be used to generate your diagnostic results and will be securely stored in our EU-hosted database.
privacy.toggle-show-details: Read more about how your data is used
privacy.detail_1: We do not ask for your name. We save your completed date, optional industry and company size, assessment answers, calculated scores, generated results, and a technical session identifier used to process the assessment.
privacy.detail_2: We use this data to provide your result, maintain assessment records, improve the diagnostic, and understand aggregate patterns. We may use aggregated, non-identifying data for analysis and benchmarking.
privacy.detail_3: Because we do not collect your name or email address, we may not be able to identify your individual submission later. If you contact us about your data, we may need your submission reference or other information that lets us locate it.
privacy.detail_4: We use browser storage on your device to temporarily save your assessment progress, including your answers and any optional industry or company size selections, so the diagnostic can continue if the page reloads or closes. This browser storage is not used for advertising, analytics, or cross-site tracking.
privacy.consent: I have read the privacy notice and understand how my responses will be used.

questionnaire.warn: Please place your dot in the triangle before continuing.

results.main-sub-title-2: Where you are strongest - and where you have room to grow
results.main-sub-description-2: These scores reflect your patterns across all 20 scenarios - four for each of the andQfive Quotients. They are not a judgement of you as a person - they show how the environment you operate in tends to behave under pressure. This report is relevant whether you lead a team, work as part of one, or both.

results.score-description: Readiness = Preparedness × Resilience. The multiplication is deliberate - someone who collapses on one dimension is not ready, regardless of how strong the other is.

callout.intro: These three priorities come from where your scores are lowest across the Five Quotients.
callout.reminder: Remember: Readiness = Preparedness × Resilience. A gap in either dimension cannot be covered by strength in the other.
callout.final_with_chips: Small, consistent shifts in {chips} will do more than a significant effort in an area where you are already strong.
callout.final_fallback: Small, consistent shifts where your scores are lowest will do more than a significant effort in an area where you are already strong.

focus.offer-next-subtitle: Open it by booking the conversation.
focus.offer-next-cta: You have seen the pattern. Book the debrief and arrive ready for the conversation.
focus.offer-next-closing-lede-1: The actions above are prepared for a reason. The right next move is specific to your pattern. A generic list would be motivational confetti. What you need is a conversation.
focus.offer-next-closing-lede-2: We have had this conversation before. We know which question cuts through. And we can almost guarantee it is not the one you are already asking yourself.
focus.offer-next-closing-lede-3: Thirty minutes. Your scores, your patterns, your next move.
focus.sit-with-subheading: These are questions to sit with, not problems to solve immediately. There are no right answers — just honest ones.

pattern.lede_intro: A Readiness score is a starting point.
pattern.lede_bold: Not a verdict. Not a destination.

pattern.main_paragraph: Your {aLabel} is at {aScore}. Your {bLabel} is at {bScore}. That specific combination — {combination} — shows up in a predictable way. {symptom}

symptom.alignment|emotion: You may find yourself avoiding difficult conversations, or struggling to maintain trust and morale when the pressure is on.
symptom.alignment|mind: You may find yourself in meetings where the direction sounds clear but nothing moves, or in strategy sessions that are misread despite repeated explanations.
symptom.alignment|vitality: You may find yourself losing shape over the week, with shifting priorities and a gap between what you meant to build and what got built.
symptom.emotion|execution: You may find yourself postponing calls or actions you knew were right, leading to a sense of frustration and missed opportunities.
symptom.emotion|mind: You may find yourself making decisions too quickly to feel confident, or struggling with conversations you keep meaning to have.
symptom.execution|alignment: You may find yourself in projects that drift, with quietly multiplying priorities and a gap between what got shipped versus what was planned.
symptom.execution|vitality: You may find yourself running out of fuel before completing work, with commitments dissolving and a gap between what got done versus what mattered.
symptom.mind|vitality: You may find yourself in strategy sessions that drain your energy, making decisions on an empty tank, and struggling with unclear thinking.
